rawItems.title: Warboys Parish Council Meeting Minutes (10 July 2026)
rawItems.content:
WARBOYS PARISH COUNCIL

Minutes  of a  meeting of   Warboys Parish Council  held on  10 th   Ju ly   2026  at the  Warboys  Community Centre ,  High Street, PE28 2TA .

IN ATTENDANCE     16  members of public,   CCC Cllr R Martin  and  HDC Cllr  D  McIlwain .

PRESENT WERE

Cllr  R Dykstra

Cllr  K Manchett

Cllr  D Parker

Cllr J Parker

Cllr S Perkins (Chair)

Cllr C Sproats

Cllr S White

Cllr A Wyatt

Mrs L Moore:- Asst. Clerk

Mrs N Webster:- CAPALC Locum Clerk

M eeting commenced   at  7 . 00   p.m

1 44 /26 WELCOME

Chair  Perkin s  opened the meeting.

1 45 /2 6  APOLOGIES FOR ABSENCE

Apologies for absence were noted for;

Cllr G Willis

Cllr L Willis

1 46 /26 MEMBERS INTERESTS

Declarations

None

Dispensations

None

150/26 OPEN FORUM - MOVED FORWARD AT DISCRETION OF CHAIR

It was proposed by the Chair and unanimously  RESOLVED  to adjourn the meeting for a maximum period of 10 minutes to hold a public forum.

The meeting was adjourned at 7. 07 p.m and reconvened at 7. 19  p.m

Multiple residents including B.Lake spoke in relation to agenda item 148/26

A  resident raised issues on storm drains along the high street.

Another resident raised issues regarding the Weir lamps.

HDC Cllr C Lowe arrived during the above discussions at 7:10pm.

1 x resident left after the above item finished  at  7: 19 pm.

1 47 /26 MINUTES OF  8 th   JUNE  2026

AMENDMENT AND SIGNED

136/26   b) Receive an  the   internal auditor report

141/26 Cllr J Parker left the meeting due to having a  pecuniary  non-registerable interest in agenda item 142/26 and was absent for the duration of the discussion, consideration, and vote on the matter (8.20pm)

Chair Perkins left the meeting due to having a  pecuniary  non-registerable interest in agenda item 142/26 and was absent for the duration of the discussion, consideration, and vote on the matter. (8.35pm-9.17pm)

Upon consideration of the recommendations of the HR Committee meeting held on 13th May 2026, S-HR 05/26, t he following resolutions were unanimously  RESOLVED  by all members present  It was unanimously  RESOLVED  to note the following decisions previou sly made :

It was  RESOLVED  by all Members present, the Minutes of the meeting held on   8 th   June   202 6  be signed as a correct record by the   Chair .

148/26 EXTRAORDINARY MINUTES OF 3 rd  JULY 2026

With the amendment of Steph Wilcox attendance added  It was  RESOLVED  by all Members present, the Minutes of the meeting held on 3 rd  July 2026 be signed as a correct record by the Chair.

1 49 /2 6  CLERK’S REPORT

Report from Clerk attached as Addendum.

151/26 REPORT BY DISTRICT COUNCILLORS

Cllr C Lowe report is attached as an addendum.

Cllr McIlwain thanked residents for their support following his family member's funeral held in Warboys and thanked for the information she had provided.

Reported that the ivy issue is now being addressed and offered his assistance if any further help is required.

Advised that an update on Local Government Reorganisation (LGR) is expected later this week. Huntingdonshire District Council supports  Option E , although it appears a decision may already have been made. A further update will be provided when possible.

Confirmed that the disabled parking bay at Flaxon Walk was completed that day, ahead of the anticipated timescale.

Advised that the Local Plan is due to be published in September and encouraged members to submit any comments during the consultation period.

Confirmed he will be looking into the future of Newman Stores, including speaking with the owner and liaising with the planning department to help move the matter forward.

Cllr Ross Martin provided an update on Cambridgeshire County Council (CCC), advising that decisions are beginning to be made ahead of Local Government Reorganisation (LGR).

Reported that LGR will affect highway maintenance contractors.

Advised that, from September, if highway repairs are carried out to an unsatisfactory standard, councillors should report them to him. New reporting arrangements will be introduced, and contractors may face financial penalties for poor-quality work.

Confirmed he is happy to assist by reporting highway issues where necessary.

Reported that Cambridgeshire County Council is forecasting a £60 million overspend on Special Educational Needs and Disabilities (SEND), representing around 50% of the service's budget.

Advised that, despite the significant overspend, there has not yet been any noticeable improvement in the service and encouraged councillors to report any specific SEND issues so that they can be raised.

Cllr S. White suggested that it may be worthwhile contacting the local school to discuss any SEND-related concerns and gather further information.

Cllr R Martin & 1x Resident left at 20:01pm

HDC Cllr McIlwain left at 20:03pm

152/26 – COMMITTEE REPORTS

To receive an update on committee meetings: -

F&GP – unable to hold – not quorate.

HR – postponed due to  extraordinary  meeting.

Community, Projects and Events – held 6 th  July.

Cllr S White updated members  and advised  of three upcoming community events:

Feast Week Street Market  – the Parish Council will be running a tombola stall to raise funds for biodiversity projects.

Community Showcase  – to be held on  12 September .

Choir Event  – scheduled for  27 September , with a further update to be provided by Sheila  following a meeting on Wednesday .

It was reported that the sports activities programme is now fully booked due to high demand, and it is hoped that additional spaces may be made available.

153/26 INTERNAL AUDITORS REPORT (From visit - 10 th  June 2026)

Deferred to a later date.

HDC Cllr C Lowe left at 20:29pm

154/26 ACCOUNTS

It was proposed by Cllr  C   Sproats , seconded by Cllr K Manchett and unanimously  RESOLVED  to approve the payments for the past month.  Appendix 1

155/26 BUDGETARY CONTROL

The members received a copy of the budgetary control statement for July 2026.  Appendix 2

Cllr S Perkins raised a query where the £50,000 budget line sits.

156/26 NOTICES AND MATTERS FOR THE NEXT AGENDA

For members of the Council to raise any matters to be included in the next agenda.

Co-option

There being no further business, the meeting was declared closed at  20 . 33   pm

The next meeting of Warboys Parish Council will be held on  1 0 th   August   202 6 .

Chairman.

Date .

APPENDIX 1 –  Accounts  1 54 /26

APPENDIX  2  – BUDGETARY CONTROL  1 55 /26
